market.question: Will the highest temperature in Los Angeles be between 64-65°F on May 4?

assessment.reasoning: NWS-style forecast for LA Monday May 4 has highs near 71°F mostly sunny with 30% chance of showers. LAX (coastal) typically runs ~3-5°F cooler than downtown. Today (May 3) LAX area near 65°F. The 64-65°F bucket therefore has some chance from marine layer holding/cooling but is below the central forecast.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Marine layer persistence at LAX vs broader basin warming.
